body:
Whether you’re an editor, designer, hobbyist, or student that wants to improve your concentration while doing your tasks, it will be ideal for you to have an ANC earbud set.

‍Noise-canceling earbuds are designed to reduce the noise around you if you want to be able to focus on work, learning, or something else you're doing.

What are the best noise-canceling earbuds?

And since it is one of the most essential things that any creative person must have, I wanted to give you my most recommended ANC earbuds.

But before that, let’s talk about the benefits and advantages of having noise-canceling earbuds first.

Aside from the fact that this product can help you focus more on your work, it also improves your conversation.

‍Whether you’re having a conference call with your client or just simply talking to your family and friends, noise-canceling earbuds can help you communicate clearly.

On the other hand, if you’re a video editor or a music producer, this product will help you have a better listening experience.

‍However, since there are a lot of noise-canceling earbud brands on the market today, you might have a hard time finding the most suitable product for you.

That’s why in this article, I wanted to give you some options to choose from to help you decide which one is a must-buy for you.

So without further ado, let’s dive into my list of the 10 best noise-canceling earbuds to buy in 2022.

Do you want to add your product to the list?—Find my address on the contact page and send your product for review.

10 Best Noise Cancelling Earbuds

  1. Apple AirPods Pro—Best overall
  2. Sony WF-1000XM4—Best value
  3. Samsung Galaxy Buds—Best buy
  4. Panasonic Wireless—Best for online class
  5. Anker Liberty Air 2 Pro—Best everyday
  6. Nura Wireless Earbuds—Best for editing
  7. Bose QuietComfort Earbuds—Best Bose
  8. MASTER & DYNAMIC MW07—Best for travel
  9. Beats Studio Wireless Buds—Best budget
  10. Bowers & Wilkins PI5—Best for gaming

How to choose the best noise cancelling earbuds

Accessories like ANC earbuds are one of the most essential things that a creative must have.

That’s why in this article, I included a noise cancelling earbuds buying guide to help you buy the most suitable product for you.

  1. ANC Effectiveness
  2. Sound Quality
  3. Battery Life
  4. Overall Comfort

And before buying any of the product on my list, here are the things to consider when buying an ANC earbuds.

ANC Effectiveness

Obviously, the most important thing that you must consider when buying noise-canceling earbuds is their efficacy.

Did you know that not all ANC earbuds provide the same performance and effectiveness?

That’s right—that’s why it is necessary for you to check the overall performance of the product before buying it.

Sound Quality

Aside from testing the effectiveness of noise-cancelling earbuds, it is also necessary to assess the quality of the sound they produce.

It is best if you purchase an ANC earbud that can produce clear sound at both low and high volumes.‍

In that way, you will be able to communicate better and you can improve your listening experience.

Battery Life

When buying true wireless earbuds, it is also important to check how long it will take before the earbuds run out of power.

Since, as creatives, we work for a long period of time, we don’t want to be interrupted while doing our tasks, right?

That’s why it would be advantageous if you buy noise-canceling earbuds that have a great battery life and can last hours of usage.

Overall Comfort

Although the comfortability of using ANC earbuds is not a technical consideration, it is also one of the most important things to check on.

Aside from the noise cancellation effectiveness, good sound quality, and good battery life, we must also consider how comfortable we are while using the product.

This will allow you to work seamlessly without being irritated or feeling any discomfort in your ears.

1. Apple AirPods Pro

If you’re looking for the best noise-canceling earbuds for Apple devices, then the AirPods Pro are definitely a must-buy.

The best overall noise-canceling earbuds for creatives.

In order to prevent you from hearing noise, its microphones detect it from both outside and within the ear, and then counteract it with equivalent anti-noise.

‍Transparency mode, sweat and water resistance, and an adjustable fit all come standard with these active noise-cancelling Apple AirPods Pro.

To activate transparency mode, hold down the force sensor for a few seconds.

This lets you hear and interact with the environment around you.

Additionally, this device has three sizes of silicone tips for a comfortable fit in your ear.

‍The Apple AirPods Pro are definitely a great choice if you’re looking for the best quality noise-canceling earbuds in 2022.

Specifications

Battery Life: 4.5hrs (buds), 24hrs (incl. case)

‍Waterproofing: IPX4

‍Special Features: Quick access to Siri by saying “Hey Siri”

  1. Comfortable
  2. Excellent Design

  2. Expensive

2. Sony WF-1000XM4

The next product on my list is the Sony WF-1000XM4, one of the high-end noise-cancelling earbuds today.

The best value in wireless noise-canceling earbuds.

It has exceptional sound quality with its new Integrated Processor V1 and supporting LDAC codec.‍

‍It can provide you with crystal-clear call quality, a beamforming microphone and a bone-conduction sensor provide clear voice detection even in noisy environments.

The Sony WF-1000XM4 is an ideal option for those creatives that are looking for the most durable noise-canceling earbuds.

Additionally, this product boasts a long-battery life that can last up to 8 hours of continuous use.

Lastly, it comes in a shape that matches the ear cavity with a new ergonomic surface design for a more stable fit.

So if you want to try the quality of one of the most expensive noise-canceling earbuds today, then the Sony WF-1000XM4 is for you.

Specifications

‍Waterproofing: IPX4

‍Special Features: LDAC Support, Speak to Chat, Touch Panel

  2. Great build

3. Samsung Galaxy Buds

One of the best-selling noise-canceling earbuds on the market today is the Samsung Galaxy Buds.‍

The best buy on noise-canceling earbuds for designers.

It comes at an affordable price, which makes it suitable for creatives and hobbyists.

‍This product has an open design that creates a live listening environment, suiting those who prefer a natural, spacious sound.

‍And if you want to block out background noise whenever you are, all you need to do is turn on the active noise cancellation.

‍Moreover, it has a long-lasting battery life with a case that doubles as a wireless charger.

The Samsung Galaxy Buds are an excellent option for designers looking for the best noise-cancelling earbuds under $100.‍

Specifications

Battery Life: 8H Buds/29H w/Case (ANC OFF)

‍Waterproofing: IPX2

‍Special Features: Bluetooth 5.0, Ergonomic and tipless design for comfort ear-fit, AKG-tuned 12mm

4. Panasonic True Wireless Earbuds

If you want true wireless earbuds that provide industry-leading noise-canceling performance, stable connectivity, and rich, crystal-clear audio, then check this out.

These are the best noise-canceling earbuds for students.

‍Panasonic Earbuds are an ideal device to use whether you are listening to music, on a call, or browsing through video content.

‍In addition to its smart design, it is also water resistant for protection from sweat and splashes.

Its high-performance MEMS mic in a unique labyrinth structure reduces wind noise and transmits voice clearly.

‍To sum it up, Panasonic earbuds are smart, lightweight, and compact, designed to deliver a high-quality audio experience no matter where you are.

So if you’re looking for the best noise-canceling earbuds for calls and online classes, the Panasonic True Wireless Earbuds are a must-have.

Specifications

Battery Life: 6.5hrs

‍Waterproofing: IPX4

5. Anker Liberty Air 2 Pro

Regardless of whether you’re a professional or a hobbyist, as long as you need the best everyday noise-canceling earbuds, this product is for you.

The best noise cancelling earbuds for everyday use.

The Liberty Air 2 Pro has been designed to sound great even with the ANC turned on, which not all earbuds can do.

‍The triple-mode noise-canceling feature of this product means that you can get near-silence in any setting.

With profiles for indoor, outdoor, and transportation, you can get away from everything and listen to pure sound from any place.

And that’s what makes the Anker Liberty Air 2 Pro the best noise-canceling earbuds for working out, or any activity that you do every day.

Moreover, Liberty Air 2 Pro includes a plethora of ear tips to ensure maximum comfort for all users.

So, if you want to have the best earbuds with ANC that you can use while doing your everyday tasks, this is the right product for you.

6. Nura Wireless Earbuds

If you’re a creative professional that is looking for the best ANC earbuds for music production and video editing, then the Nura Wireless Earbuds are for you.

The best noise-canceling earbuds for editing.

Its ANC filters out up to 20 decibels of background noise, so you can fully experience your music no matter where you are or whenever you want.

‍One of the best things about this product is that in just two and a half hours, you’ll have a fully charged case and six hours of continuous music.

Also, your case will charge your NURATRUE three more times—for up to 24 hours of listening.

‍Using Nura Wireless Earbuds, you can choose the way you tap and double-tap to take calls, activate voice assistants, and more.

So, if you're looking for the best noise-cancelling earbuds for editors, the Nura Wireless Earbuds are a great option.

7. Bose QuietComfort

I included this product on my list since I am often asked about what the best noise-canceling earbuds from Bose are.

The best Bose noise-canceling earbuds in 2022.

The Bose QuietComfort sounds fantastic when it comes to music quality, which is an extra advantage.

‍Compared to other models, these ANC earbuds are more consistent at keeping things quiet when you need them to.

And we enjoy that you can set custom levels for them within the app, and you can then cycle through those quickly from the earphones.

The Bose QuietComfort earbuds themselves are rather large, and the accompanying case is a true beast.

However, if you don't mind the weight and are looking for foolproof noise-canceling capabilities, these are the best products for you.

Overall, the Bose QuietComfort is an excellent choice for those who are looking for the best noise-canceling earbuds for working from home.

8. MASTER & DYNAMIC MW07

If you’re a freelance designer that wants to buy the best noise-canceling earbuds for travel, the MASTER & DYNAMIC MW07 is a must-buy.

These are the best noise-canceling earbuds for travel.

This produces a wide soundstage and a lot of fine detail and natural clarity.

‍The noise cancellation is also really good, but it isn't quite as good as the Bose and Sony headphones, which are clearly superior.

But still, the MASTER & DYNAMIC MW07 is a perfect choice if you want to have the best mid-range noise-cancelling earbuds today.

Additionally, even when its battery dies, you'll be able to get back to work in 15 minutes with a half-charged bud.

The MASTER & DYNAMIC MW07 is a great choice to buy if you want the best portable noise-canceling earbuds for travel.

For creatives on a budget that are looking for an earbud with ANC, the Beats Studio Buds are definitely for you.

The best budget noise-canceling earbuds for creatives.

Aside from the fact that it is low cost, it is still one of my most recommended noise-canceling earbuds to buy.

‍When it comes to call quality, these are a little behind some of the other models on this list, but for the price, they're still a very tempting choice.

This is a lively and entertaining track, with an exceptional warmth to it that Beats is now well-known for.

They're really comfortable to wear for extended periods of time, which makes them ideal for in-demand professionals.

And because they're small and lightweight for noise cancellers, they're also incredibly "wearable" in general.

Lastly, if you want to buy the best affordable noise-canceling earbuds today, then the Beats Studio Buds are the ones that you need.

10. Bowers & Wilkins PI5

As the last product on this list, I don’t want to miss including the best gaming noise-canceling earbuds, which are the Bowers & Wilkins PI5.‍

These are the best noise-canceling earbuds for gaming.

The Bowers & Wilkins PI5 ensures consistent connectivity and high-fidelity streaming from your phone, tablet, or PC.

‍It features a multi-function button on the left earbud that allows you to choose between three levels of adaptive noise cancellation.

‍They are also equipped with four microphones for enhanced call clarity.

Moreover, the Bowers & Wilkins PI5 comes with a sturdy charging case equipped with two 350mAh rechargeable batteries.

Each earbud has a touch-sensitive multifunction button that enables playback and phone call control with single, double, or triple presses.

So if you want to buy the best noise-canceling earbuds for gamers, the Bowers & Wilkins PI5 is for you.

Conclusions

One of the most essential devices that an editor, designer, or creative person in general must have is noise-canceling earbuds.‍

What are the best wireless noise-cancelling earbuds?

If you’re going to ask me this question, I will definitely recommend the Apple AirPods Pro, which is the most suitable for Apple products.

However, if you’re looking for the best Bose noise-canceling earbuds, then I suggest you buy the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds.

You might also consider buying the Beats Studio Wireless Buds in case you’re interested in buying the best-selling ANC earbuds.

‍Whether you want to have the best noise-canceling earbuds for gaming or editing, I’ve got you all covered.

I also mention the things to consider when buying ANC earbuds to help you decide which one of them to buy.
